REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. W. REGISTRY
File No. 2554/13
Section 2, S.B. Station
Date October 24. 19 32
Subject (in full) Communist Meeting held in the Western District, O.O.L.
Made by Clerk Zung Zoong Oen Forwarded by O B Ku. O.
It is reported that some twelve cotton mill workers
employed in Japanese industrial concerns in the Western District,
who are Red adherents, held a secret meeting in a straw hut
near the Yoong Yui(永豫 )Cotton Mill, Tan Ka Doo(谈家渡),
Western Chapel, between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m. October 22. The
gathering which was presided over by Ling Ying(林英 ), a
representative of the local branch of the Mutual Aid Society,
passed the following resolutions:-
1) That a number of cotton mill workers proceed to the gaol
at Lukawei, French Concession, at 11.30 a.m. October 24
and demand the gaol authorities to allow the sending of
winter clothing to those who have been arrested in connection
with the Anti-Japanese movement.
2) That propaganda parties for the delivering of lectures and
shouting of slogans be organized to assist the "Winter-
Clothing-Party" in forcing the French Authorities to release
the Anti-Japanese elements who are in gaol.
Zung Zoong Oen
Clerk
